temporal_notes: Early morning mosquito collections performed monthly over 4 consecutive days between August and December 2013 (T0-T4).
coord_source_text: The study was conducted in VK3 village in the Kou Valley (11° 23′ 14″N; 4° 24′ 42″W), a rice-growing area of southwestern Burkina Faso, located 30 km north of Bobo-Dioulasso (Fig. 1).
source_text: A sub-sample of 165 mosquitoes (50±10 per arm for resistance gene characterization) was molecularly analysed for species identification within the An. gambiae complex, and were all identified as An. coluzzii.
